50 | Divine Will | caster | 1 hr/lvl | self | Us

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Adds +10 to one maneuver the round after this spell is cast. No other action
can be performed until this maneuver is resolved.
@@ 2
Caster is healed of one area of up to mild frostbite or first degree burns.
@@ 3
Caster can ignore up to -10 in accrued penalties from injuries or concussion
hit loss.
@@ 4
Allows caster to stop bleeding on a wound that is bleeding I hit per round;
for I hour, caster can move at no more than a walking pace, or bleeding will
resume at prior rate.
@@ 5
Caster is relieved of one round’s worth of accumulated stun effects.
@@ 6
Caster is able to sustain an additional 25% of his total concussion hits
before passing out. Hits are still taken and remain when the spell lapses.
@@ 7
Will reduce damage to the caster by I hit every minute as long as the caster
concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him
without concentration.
@@ 8
As Clotting I, except that caster can stop bleeding in a wound that is
bleeding up to 3 hits per round.
@@ 9
As Tolerance I, except up to -20 in accrued penalties can be ignored.
@@ 10
As Inner Focus I, except the bonus is +30.
@@ 11
As Unpain I, except an additional 50% can be sustained.
@@ 12
As Regeneration I, except caster’s damage is reduced by 2 hits per minute of
concentration.
@@ 13
As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal three areas of mild damage or
one area of mild and one area of moderate damage, or one area of severe damage
(e.g., thirddegree burn).
@@ 14
Caster can cure any one paralysis problem.
@@ 15
As Clotting I, except that all blood loss (i.e. hits per round) from one wound
is stopped.
@@ 16
As Pain I, except an additional 75% can be sustained.
@@ 17
As Tolerance I, except up to 30 points in accrued penalties can be ignored.
@@ 18
As Stun Relief I except relieves all accrued stun.
@@ 19
Caster can remove any one poison from his system.
@@ 20
As Inner Focus I, except the bonus is +50.
@@ 25
As Regeneration I, except caster’s damage is reduced by 5 hits per minute of
concentration.
@@ 30
As Tolerance I, except up to -50 in accrued penalties can be ignored.
@@ 50
The caster is aided by his deity for the duration of one mission (GM’s
discretion as to what a mission constitutes). The caster ignores all penalties
from wounds and hit loss, and he can take double his normal hits total before
falling unconscious. He is also at +10 activity to all actions that further
the mission.
